rationale: The agent correctly verified the user (full name + zip matched a single user), inspected orders, and acted only on the authenticated user’s delivered orders. However, after asking for confirmation to return only the two skateboards, the user expanded the request to include a smartwatch and an e-reader. The agent then submitted a return for the two skateboards plus the smartwatch without first restating the full set of changes and obtaining explicit confirmation for that expanded action, violating the policy requirement to confirm exact changes before any write. The e-reader return was handled correctly with explicit confirmation. Refund details matched the stored credit card. Due to the unconfirmed write for the smartwatch, this interaction fails the pass bar.
